title: ChatConversationV1
description: Additive /chat and /chat/stream request fields; omitted memory_mode preserves stateless clients. Scope comes exclusively from the authenticated Workspace principal.
x-behavior: Personal conversations require tenant plus owner; team conversations share within the authorized tenant.
Concurrent turns detected before streaming return HTTP 409. A renewable server-side lease and CAS fence stale workers; failures after SSE headers use an error event.
Per-conversation call caps are 40 model and 30 tool calls; reservations are durable and unused calls are refunded on completion or handled cancellation.

Memory is bounded to four recent turns / 2200 characters, with optional 1400-character summary advancing at most six older turns. It supplies topic hints only; evidence is reauthorized and retrieved on every turn.

SSE deltas are provisional. Only done carries the final citation-reviewed ChatResponse; a disconnect cancels streaming and does not append an incomplete conversation turn. A turn already completed before cancellation was observed may remain stored.
JSON and SSE use the same planning, retrieval, governance, memory and metrics pipeline. API keys, raw provider errors and unapproved write effects never enter events.
